summary: 3.1B Schedule Profile & Date Override Workflow. /schedule/ gains named schedule profiles (create, edit, clone, activate with a concurrency check, archive/restore, guarded delete), explicit editing of inactive profiles, and one-date overrides with weekly inheritance and Revert to Weekly. Existing logs and their profile provenance are untouched; nothing is rebuilt automatically. No migrations, requirements, packages, systemd units, static assets, nginx, engine or protected-runtime changes.
